title.quote:
CAMMARL : Conformal Action Modeling in

Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: Title as given at the top of the paper.
title.value: CAMMARL: Conformal Action Modeling in Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: The paper proposes CAMMARL, a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm in which an agent models other agents' actions as conformal prediction sets and uses these sets as additional inputs to its policy. It is evaluated against several baselines (NOAM, TAAM, TOAM, GIAM, EAP, APU) in Cooperative Navigation, Level-based Foraging, Pressure Plate, and Google Football environments, plus variations of the set encoding.

type.quote: Through several experiments in two fully cooperative multi-agent tasks, we show that CAMMARL elevates the capabilities of an autonomous agent in MARL
type.justification: The paper's claims are supported by experiments across four multi-agent environments with learning curves.
